leadership_and_faculty.name: Dr. To Van Khanh
leadership_and_faculty.title: Senior Lecturer / Head of SATLab
leadership_and_faculty.office: Building E3, 144 Xuan Thuy, Cau Giay, Hanoi
leadership_and_faculty.bio: Dr. To Van Khanh is the Head of SATLab and Senior Lecturer at the Faculty of Information Technology, VNU University of Engineering and Technology (UET-VNU). He specializes in Formal Automated Reasoning, SAT/MaxSAT/PB Encodings, Software Verification, Symbolic Execution, and Combinatorial Optimization, authoring publications in COAP, RAIRO-OR, and ICAART.

leadership_and_faculty.name: M.Sc. Kieu Van Tuyen
leadership_and_faculty.title: Lab Coordinator / PhD Candidate
leadership_and_faculty.office: Building E3, 144 Xuan Thuy, Cau Giay, Hanoi
leadership_and_faculty.bio: M.Sc. Kieu Van Tuyen is a PhD candidate and Lab Coordinator at SATLab UET. He coordinates research in SAT encodings for Industrial Scheduling, Assembly Line Balancing, Social Golfer, 2D Strip Packing, and Real-Time Railway Rescheduling via MaxSAT-DDD, with first-author papers in RAIRO-OR, CIT, Pesquisa Operacional, and JCO.

leadership_and_faculty.name: M.Sc. Student Truong Xuan Hieu
leadership_and_faculty.title: M.Sc. Student / Senior Researcher
leadership_and_faculty.office: Building E3, 144 Xuan Thuy, Cau Giay, Hanoi
leadership_and_faculty.bio: M.Sc. student at UET-VNU and primary developer of the SCLib architecture. First author of the breakthrough Cyclic Antibandwidth paper in Computational Optimization and Applications (COAP, Q1 ISI) and staircase cardinality counter algorithms in ICAART 2025.

leadership_and_faculty.name: M.Sc. Vu Thanh Huong
leadership_and_faculty.title: Researcher / Lecturer
leadership_and_faculty.office: Building E3, 144 Xuan Thuy, Cau Giay, Hanoi
leadership_and_faculty.bio: Researcher at SATLab specializing in Pseudo-Boolean constraints, distance-constrained graph labelings (Radio-k Labeling, k-Safe Labeling), incremental SAT solving algorithms, and formal verification methods.

leadership_and_faculty.name: M.Sc. Student Dao Xuan Nghia
leadership_and_faculty.title: M.Sc. Student / Researcher
leadership_and_faculty.office: Building E3, 144 Xuan Thuy, Cau Giay, Hanoi
leadership_and_faculty.bio: Researcher in sequence constraints, frequency assignment problems (MO-FAP), cellular network optimization, and automated decision solvers in IEEE Latin America Transactions and Constraints.
